name: Short Cut Grilled Chicken Rice Pilaf Bowl with Carrots, Arugula & Lemon Garlic Dressing

ingredients.name: rice pilaf with orzo pasta, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Squeeze rice pouches to separate grains, then tear a two-inch opening at the top of each to vent. Place both packages in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, 2 1/2 minutes. Carefully remove from microwave and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (250 g) pouch rice pilaf with orzo pasta, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Set aside.
Place chicken on a microwave-safe plate and cover with a damp paper towel. Place in microwave and heat on high until warmed through, 2 1/2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from microwave.
instructions.secondary_message: 227 g frozen chicken breast strips, fully-cooked

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice pilaf between bowls, then top with arugula, carrots, and chicken. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (283 g) bag shredded carrots
⅓ cup lemon garlic vinaigrette
